item.title: Vietnam: Science, Tech and Innovation for Next-Gen Growth
item.description: Vietnam aims to drive sustainable, high-value economic growth by placing science, technology, innovation, digital transformation and strategic research partnerships at the core of its development strategy.

item.title: Singapore: Genomic Centre Pioneers Predictive Healthcare
item.description: Singapore’s new SingHealth Genomic Assessment Centre leverages genomics and advanced data analytics to enable predictive, personalised and digitally driven healthcare nationwide, with future AI integration under study.

item.title: Malaysia: Johor’s Advanced Polymer R&D and Manufacturing Hub
item.description: Malaysia has begun constructing an advanced polymer R&D and manufacturing hub in Johor, integrating cutting-edge research, pilot development and industrial-scale production for regional and global markets.

item.title: The Philippines: Expanding Digital Access for Underserved Communities
item.description: The Bayanihan SIM Project gives students, teachers and underserved communities in the Philippines free mobile data, bridging the digital divide and enabling access to services.

item.title: Australia: Solar Panel Recycling Pilot for Sustainability
item.description: Australia has launched a national pilot programme to recycle end-of-life solar panels, aiming to significantly reduce waste, recover valuable materials efficiently and support a sustainable clean energy transition.

item.title: Indonesia, China Launch Joint AI Lab to Revolutionise Healthcare
item.description: Indonesia and China are collaborating through a joint laboratory to advance AI-driven healthcare, vaccines and genomics, promoting technology transfer, innovation and stronger health systems.

item.title: Hong Kong: Simplifying Cross-Border Radiology Record Integration
item.description: Hong Kong’s eHealth platform now enables residents to securely integrate overseas radiology reports and images into their electronic medical records, improving cross-border care continuity and data interoperability.

item.title: Vietnam: Artificial Intelligence as Key Driver for Development
item.description: Vietnam is leveraging artificial intelligence as a strategic foundation to drive innovation, strengthen national competitiveness and achieve sustainable, long-term science and technology–driven growth.

item.title: Singapore: Preparing Workers for AI and the Future of Work
item.description: Singapore Management University has launched the Resilient Workforces Institute to study the impact of AI and digital technologies on jobs, skills and lifelong learning, equipping the workforce with resilience for the future.

item.title: Singapore: SMU Empowering Workforce Resilience in the Age of AI
item.description: Singapore Management University has launched the Resilient Workforces Institute to advance workforce resilience, lifelong learning and AI-driven skills for Singapore’s rapidly evolving economy and workforce.
